observations: Photo 0 shows a stainless steel gas cooker with four burners and two control knobs on the front panel. The cooktop has a black grate and four burners, with visible signs of use and some discoloration.
Photo 1 shows the same cooker with all four burners lit, producing blue flames. The cooktop has a black grate and four burners, with a visible control knob on the right side. The background is tiled.

Photo 2 shows the back of the cooker, which is a stainless steel surface with a glass lid and a control panel with multiple buttons and a dial. The back appears to be in a different environment with a window and a wall with peeling paint.
The seller claims it is a 6-burner cooker, but only 4 burners are visible in the photos. The second burner is not visible in any photo.
The seller claims all burners are working perfectly, which is supported by photo 1 where all four burners are lit.
The cooker appears to be a standard gas range with a built-in oven, as seen in photo 2.
No brand or model is visible on the cooker in any photo.
The condition of the cooker shows signs of use, including discoloration on the cooktop and some wear on the control panel.

claims.claim: 4 Gas cooker and 2 burner making 6 burner in total.
claims.evidence: Only 4 burners are visible in the photos. The second burner is not visible, and the claim of 2 additional burners cannot be confirmed from the images.
Photo 1 shows all four burners lit, indicating they are functioning. However, the oven and other components are not shown, so functionality of the oven or other parts cannot be confirmed.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The second burner may not be present or may be non-functional.
risks.proof: A photo showing the second burner, or a video demonstrating its operation.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a 4-burner cooker, which is the visible configuration.

risks.risk: The oven may not be functional or may be damaged.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the oven door opening and closing, and the interior light or heating element working.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a gas cooker without oven, or with oven assumed non-functional.

risks.risk: The control panel or wiring may be damaged or faulty.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the control panel and a video showing the knobs and dial operating correctly.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a cooker with potential electrical or mechanical faults.

proof_requests: A photo or video showing the second burner and its operation.
A video or photo showing the oven door opening and closing, and the interior light or heating element working.
A close-up photo of the control panel and a video showing the knobs and dial operating correctly.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
